title: Showcase: the perfboard working, the board on order
summary: Show the family the soldered perfboard circuit working, walk through the schematic and layout that produced it, and report on the fabricated board's order.
materials: the working perfboard circuit from week 3
a laptop with the KiCad schematic and layout open
the Maker's Log, open to weeks 1 through 3

steps.title: Plan the presentation
steps.body:
Plan the presentation in this order.

1. Show the multimeter measurements from week 1 and say what a power budget predicts about the robot's runtime.

2. Open KiCad and show the schematic, then the two layouts from week 2, and say which one used less copper.

3. Show the perfboard circuit working, powered up, doing what the schematic says it should.

4. Report on the fabricated board: the order date, the expected arrival, and one thing you expect to check first once it lands.

Be ready for one question from the family about why a hand-soldered twin was worth building before the real board even arrived.

A caption below reminds the presenter to state the predicted battery runtime out loud first, as step 1.

steps.title: Rehearse the demo
steps.body:
Power the perfboard circuit up once before the family sees it, and confirm it still behaves the way the schematic says it should.

Practise saying the power budget's number out loud, plainly: the driving current you measured, and the hours it predicts for a fresh pack.
checklist: The perfboard circuit powers up and behaves correctly on a test run
The two KiCad layouts are ready to show side by side
The predicted runtime from week 1 can be stated as a plain number
I can answer one question about why the perfboard twin mattered

steps.title: Show the family
steps.body:
Gather the family and run the presentation in the order rehearsed: the power budget, the schematic and layouts, the working perfboard circuit, and the fabrication order.

Invite one question and answer it honestly, including saying so if a number is only a prediction and has not been checked yet.

steps.title: Show it
steps.prompt: A short recording of the perfboard circuit powering up in front of the family, plus a photo of the two KiCad layouts on screen
